banner.linkText: Sign up in under a minute →

heroSubtitle: Rolling subs, forwards and backs, named positions numbered as on the jersey, and your competition's own side size, from TriTag to 15 a side. Siren keeps playing time fair so you can stop juggling a clipboard and watch your kid play.
metaDescription: Junior rugby union game manager. Fair rolling subs, forward and back rotations, named positions 1 to 15, live tries, conversions, penalty and drop goals.

centerpiece.before: Everything you need to make game day a

finalCtaBody: Free for the entire 2026 season. Works on the phone you already have. Optional app download, no credit card.

features.body: Unlimited rolling subs, the way junior union plays. The rotation engine tracks every kid's minutes and suggests who comes on next, so playing time stays fair without you counting.
bullets: Total game time visible at a glance
A game-time floor you set (half the game by default)
Season totals carry across all games
features.imageAlt: Rotation view showing each player's forward and back field-time bars

features.body: Siren starts each age at Rugby Australia's pathway sizes and half lengths. Your state plays 10 or 15 at Under 10? Set your competition's size once and every game starts from it, and change it on the day if the opposition is short.
bullets: Pathway defaults from Under 6 to Under 18
Your team's own players on the field and half length
Any size from 5 to 15 drawn on the field
features.imageAlt: Pre-game squad screen with the players on the field for the day

features.body: From Under 10, give kids home positions from the full side, numbered as on the jersey: the front row 1 to 3, the locks 4 and 5, the back row to 8, and the backs 9 to 15. The lineup fills the positions your side size plays.
bullets: Home and also-plays positions for every kid
Positions follow your side size, 10 to 15
Forwards and backs only for the youngest ages
features.imageAlt: Player roles with forward and back lines and their colour dots

features.body: Log a try with one tap and the conversion kicker straight after. Penalty and drop goals sit beside the try once kicking for goal counts. The pathway keeps no score to Under 11, so the scoreboard starts off there and is one switch away.
bullets: Try 5, conversion 2, penalty and drop goals 3
Both teams scored from the sideline
Undo the last score in one tap
features.imageAlt: Score view with tries and a conversion-kicker picker

features.body: Mark each player available or unavailable the night before. Short of numbers? Drop the side size to match and Siren rebalances the rotation automatically.
bullets: One tap to mark a player available or unavailable
Run a smaller side to match the opposition
Last-minute changes and fill-ins handled on the day
features.imageAlt: Pre-game availability list with available/unavailable chips

features.body: Tap any player, then Player actions, to move them between forwards and backs, flag an injury, or lend them to the opposition. Siren adapts mid-game without losing track of anyone's time.
bullets: Move a player between forwards and backs
Injured players skip the rotation
Lend a player to the opposition and track their time separately
features.imageAlt: Rugby league player actions: switch player, mark injured, went home, or lend to the opposition

title.before: Hand scoring to any parent in

features.body: Send the run-link to a parent on the sideline and they become the scorer for the day. No app download, no account, no setup. A magic link gets them straight in.
bullets: Full scoring access via a single shareable link
No app download or account needed
Coach stays focused on the field
features.imageAlt: Public run-link scoring view for parents

features.body: After every game, field time and scoring update automatically. Spot who's spent the season in the forwards and give them a run in the backs.
bullets: Forward / back balance across the whole squad
Time in each named position
Top try-scorer leaderboard
features.imageAlt: Season stats dashboard with forward/back balance and try-scorer leaderboard
